title.zh: DeepSeek 与华为昇腾开源基础组件，共建 AI 芯片软件生态
title.en: 黄仁勋最担心的事情正在发生：DeepSeek开始搬离美国主导的AI技术栈，底层组件集体适配华为昇腾

current_state.zh: DeepSeek open-sourced foundational software components for Huawei's Ascend AI chips as part of a joint effort to build an efficient, easy-to-use software ecosystem around the accelerator platform.
current_state.en: DeepSeek open-sourced foundational software components for Huawei's Ascend AI chips as part of a joint effort to build an efficient, easy-to-use software ecosystem around the accelerator platform.

updates.title_zh: 黄仁勋最担心的事情正在发生：DeepSeek开始搬离美国主导的AI技术栈，底层组件集体适配华为昇腾
updates.title_en: 黄仁勋最担心的事情正在发生：DeepSeek开始搬离美国主导的AI技术栈，底层组件集体适配华为昇腾
updates.what_changed_zh: DeepSeek, working with Huawei, open-sourced a full set of AI training and inference low-level components — including the TileLang operator framework already used in DeepSeek V4 training — targeting Huawei Ascend chips as an alternative to NVIDIA's CUDA stack.
